question: How many trains were flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in January 2021 connecting the location of the Statue of Unity to different parts of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eight.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi has** flagged off eight trains connecting the Statue of Unity in Kevadiya, Gujarat **with different regions of the country through video conferencing.
 
• PM Modi informed that it was the first time in history that so many trains from different locations were flagged off for a common destination.
 
• The trains flagged off by Prime Minister today will connect Kevadiya from Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh, Dadar in Maharashtra, Ahmedabad in Gujarat, Nizamuddin in Delhi, Rewa in Madhya Pradesh and Chennai in Tamil Nadu. A MEMU train to and fro Pratapnagar from Kevadiya was also inaugurated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• PM also inaugurated other railway projects in Kevadiya, including **Dabhoi-Chandid gauge, converted broad gauge rail line, Chandod-Kevadiya new broad gauge rail line, Pratapnagar-Kevadiya newly electrified section, and new station buildings of Dabhoi Junction, Chandod, and Kevadiya**.
 
• These trains will facilitate seamless connectivity to the Statue of Unity.
 
• **Gujarat Chief Minister Vijay Rupani and Union Railway Minister Piyush Goyal were also present on the occasion. **
 
• The Prime Minister stressed the need for skilled and specialist manpower and professionals to meet the requirement of the Railways' transformation.
